title: CISA Cybersecurity Incident and Vulnerability Response Playbook

pages.text:
CISA Cybersecurity Incident and Vulnerability Response Playbook
Phase 1 & 2: Preparation, Incident Detection, and Initial Analysis
The CISA playbook outlines standardized operational procedures for responding to cybersecurity threats across institutional net
The response lifecycle comprises five distinct phases: Preparation, Detection & Analysis, Containment, Eradication & Recovery
Upon detecting anomalous activity, the incident response team must validate the threat and assign an initial severity rating withi
High-severity incidents affecting critical operations or domain controllers must be escalated to executive leadership immediately

CISA Cybersecurity Incident and Vulnerability Response Playbook
Phase 3: Containment Strategies and Forensic Evidence Preservation
Containment isolates compromised systems to prevent lateral movement while preserving volatile memory and network connec
Investigators must use write-blocking hardware when acquiring physical hard drive bitstream images to prevent evidence alterat
Forensic images and memory dumps must be verified immediately using SHA-256 cryptographic hashing to maintain integrity.
A formal Chain of Custody document must track every forensic artifact from point of acquisition through final regulatory reporting

CISA Cybersecurity Incident and Vulnerability Response Playbook
Phase 4 & 5: Eradication, Recovery, and Post-Incident Lessons Learned
Eradication involves purging adversary footholds, resetting compromised enterprise credentials, and patching exploited vulnerab
Restored systems must be connected to isolated monitoring segments for at least 72 hours of telemetry review before full produ
The incident response team must publish a final Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Lessons Learned report within 14 days of clos
Recommendations must update preventative defensive controls and firewall ingress rules to prevent recurrent exploitation.
